source_refs.note: Topic 7.7 as printed (PDF 102-103, printed 98-99): interpreting test results, presenting findings clearly, connecting conclusions to hypotheses.

blocks.text: Communicating results and conclusions is an important step in data analysis and research. It helps readers understand what the data shows and what decisions can be made. Clear communication ensures that results are not misunderstood or misused. Researchers must explain findings in a simple and logical manner. Conclusions should be based strictly on analyzed data. Proper communication improves transparency and credibility. Effective reporting also supports future research and decision-making.

Interpreting test results involves understanding what statistical outcomes mean. It includes analyzing values such as p-values, confidence levels, or test statistics. Results help determine whether a hypothesis is accepted or rejected. Researchers must consider the context of the data while interpreting results. Misinterpretation can lead to incorrect conclusions. Clear explanation of results is essential for accuracy. Proper interpretation ensures reliable and meaningful findings.

Presenting findings clearly helps readers easily understand research outcomes. Results should be organized in a logical and structured way. Tables, charts, and graphs can be used to support explanations. Simple language should be used instead of technical jargon. Key points must be highlighted for better understanding. Clear presentation reduces confusion and improves communication. Well-presented findings make the research more effective and useful.

Conclusions must be directly linked to the original hypotheses. Researchers should clearly state whether the hypothesis is supported or not. Data and test results should justify the conclusion. Personal opinions should not influence the final conclusion. Clear connections strengthen the validity of research. This step ensures logical consistency in the study. Connecting conclusions to hypotheses completes the research process effectively.
